annotations.title: Whale transfers: big USDC and USDT moves

description: Whale transfers: the largest USDC and USDT transfers of the last minutes on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Polygon above a size you choose (default 100,000 USD), with sender, receiver, amount and transaction. Use for whale alerts, flow monitoring and market-moving transfers. Example: chain=ethereum. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

chain.description: ethereum (default), base, arbitrum, optimism or polygon

min.description: Smallest transfer in USD, 10000 or more (default 100000)

minutes.description: How far back, 1 to 15 minutes (default 5; Base covers at most 3)
